title: RAW whole f108r final paragraph: one assembled amulet through wearing and removal, with attributed benefit kept separate
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED. The complete immediate successor of the fixed33-terminal commentary is nominated for a use/handling account. Keep all88 old values and the exact old binary alternatives. Removal from the wearer changes WORN_BY without destroying the stone/engraving/seed/part assembly; a renewed wearing assertion requires a written event or explicitly retrospective scope. The fixed protection words remain attributed claims.
phase: bounded exploratory proposal; no target test or new meaning confirmed
access: Existing primary meaning contracts and metadata only for newly nominated adjoining units. No raw target census, new image, reserve, source download, contact, semantic execution or code. All hypotheses are previously exposed or newly proposed exploration, not holdout confirmation.
claim_ceiling: A successful complete draft could supply a constrained working reading and a written consequence; it would not prove any word, source identity or historical meaning. No experiment may start before a full exact draft and separate review.

target.missing_reader_rule: An empty RF1b array is NO_WHOLE_READER in this cache. It is not permission to fabricate paragraph boundaries or import another edition’s groups. If a complete owned corresponding line union is later found, retain its native boundary status separately.

fixed_inputs.lexicon: Exactly71+17=88 fixed entries with full denotations; original9 and extension4 constructions retained. Existing source uncertainties and original diplomatic failures remain. No merge with the separate seed-rite, powder or music family.
fixed_inputs.packing: The old finite atomic/binary alternatives using the88 old entries are retained as alternatives, with their exact directions and all known homographs. New values, if any, are atomic whole forms only; they do not enlarge the old component dictionary, create new splits, or eliminate any old alternative. This explicit limited continuation is not a new general packing law.
fixed_inputs.identities: Old S stone, I depiction, G grape seed, branch-selected P physical bird part, A assembly and W persistent wearer stay distinct. WEARER denotes W even when W is not currently wearing A. Old cheedar WEAR still puts A on that same W; it is not a free transfer to any newly introduced person.
fixed_inputs.scope: The old completed making trace and all its AFTER/THROUGHOUT invariants retain their original finite scope. A new use episode may start from its final physical state, but must be overtly bound; extending old temporal quantification is not free.

design.whole_content_offer: A full continuation distinguishes the intact assembled object from its being on the wearer: wearing, temporary removal/keeping, and any renewed wearing concern the same A and W. The old claim about protection can be repeated or qualified, but it is neither a health event nor proof that the object is worn. Every new clause must belong to this complete use/handling account, including any contrast or instruction. No removed/reapplied sequence is asserted to occur in the manuscript before its words are read.
new_written_obligation: If the full new paragraph describes removing A from W and subsequently asserts WORN_BY(A,W) at a later time, it must supply a restoring wear event or a fixed non-current scope. The noun WEARER alone cannot restore the relation.

Removing A from W is distinct from taking P out of A or erasing I. A clause reusing WING_TIP_OF, STONE or HOSTED_BY must preserve the old typed objects; no implicit disassembly, fresh seed or depicted-to-physical substitution.

Any CLAIMS_PROTECTS statement remains a proposition attributed to the source; neither renewed wearing nor a claim licenses actual relief. A change from stone-topic to assembly bearer must use one declared construction, not a choice made per occurrence.
design.capacity_gate: Before assigning unknowns, require at least one literal exact raw form from {qokedy,sy,sheckhy,lchedy,lkeedy,qokeedy,cheey,sheol} and at least one from {qokey,qokaiin,qopshdy,cheedar,chedy,dcheokedy}. These are explicitly fixed physical-object/relation and wearer/purpose/claim inventories. Literal presence is only capacity, not selection of an atomic sense over a retained binary alternative. If either set is absent, stop this nominated continuation without synonyms or another paragraph; satisfying this gate does not prove a written wear-state dependency.

rivals.meaning: A new temporally bound use episode changes worn state while preserving the assembled object.
All relevant new clauses are attributed or conditional descriptions. No actual removal or rewearing is asserted; explicit modal scope must account for the whole unit.
The new paragraph refers back to stages of the original making trace. Every apparently later physical predicate needs a reusable written retrospective construction, not a per-occurrence time reset.

strongest_countercases: GDT1038 solves the whole extension IT representation, not the original diplomatic paragraph; ZL original has3 unbound forms, IT9. This new draft cannot erase those earlier failures.
The old f108r C11 stone-topic assembly anaphora and direct-stone-claim rival both remain. Neither is refuted by ordinary physical coherence.
No present source paragraph states this new use/removal account; it is an explicit analytical continuation hypothesis. The old finite trace must not silently acquire an indefinite AFTER invariant.
If the next paragraph supplies only free new words, this would be another fitted story; the literal reuse gate and full type/reference obligations are mandatory.
design.smallest_next_retrieval: Freeze the entire nominated unit before opening its word body. Retain every position and every already-owned alternate reading. After selection, first report exact inherited matches and all unknown forms, then attempt the complete paragraph within the declared caps. A failed coverage/cost gate closes this nomination; no fallback paragraph, source normalization, new aliases or cap increase. Preserve the best full incomplete draft with its exact remaining obligations.
design.outcomes: Complete fixed-value reuse with a genuine written wear/state dependency supports retaining this narrow construction family for further development; complete incompatible argument/scope obligations close only this continuation. Absent old category capacity or unfinished syntax is MISSING_BINDING, not a global refutation.
